A 6.3, Soup_Kitchen22. Even the best barbecue gets a little charred sometimes.

THE GOOD

+ Every time you found BellyTb1, something good happened.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. Nice piece of business.
+ 1 shot on target: +0.1. Nicely done.

THE BAD
- Their best forward posted 8.5 to your 6.3. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Their humans averaged 8.2 to our 6.9; we were second best man for man. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Shots: 1. Mid-pack today, 3+ tomorrow.
- A one-goal loss (1-2): a single moment decided it. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (6 of 11). No silver lining on this one. Let's just make sure it never happens again. Here's the fix: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

This week's homework: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.

Listen here, Soup_Kitchen22: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Water the plant; it'll grow. - Coach Lasso
